dedupe_keys.name: cross border road transport infrastructure in the european union jrc accessibility and network efficiency grid

description: This Joint Research Centre dataset gives road accessibility and network efficiency indicators for every 1 km by 1 km grid cell within 75 km of an internal land border of the European Union. For each cell it lists the NUTS 3 region, the country and the neighbouring country across the border, the cell population, the population reachable within 75 km on the national and international sides, a location indicator (population-weighted travel time to the five largest settlements), potential accessibility, and a network efficiency ratio comparing actual road travel times to ideal ones, each for the national and the international side. It was produced by A. Christodoulou and P. Christidis for DG REGIO and used in the Seventh Cohesion Report (2017). The table (about 44 MB, CSV or tab-delimited) and a PDF data dictionary are free under CC0 with no access limits from the JRC Data Catalogue and a Harvard Dataverse copy (doi 10.7910/DVN/ZDSMAE). Caveats: it is a 2017 snapshot, the road network and travel speeds behind it are not included, cells near several borders appear once per border, and it covers land borders only. The indicators support network flow and capacity planning studies of cross-border road links, for example ranking where missing links cut access; related records are Eurostat transport statistics and the ANAS Italy road graph.
name: Cross-border road transport infrastructure in the European Union (JRC accessibility and network efficiency grid)
